description: Wingtip is designing a net-new IoT telemetry ingestion platform on Azure for device fleets up to 500k endpoints. Review ingestion, stream processing, hot/warm storage, and operator dashboards for scalability, cost, and security before build funding.
constraints: Ingestion must tolerate regional outage with documented degradation
Device identity via X.509 or symmetric keys — no anonymous ingress
Hot path p95 latency under 2s to alerting bus
requiredCapabilities: Azure IoT Hub or equivalent ingress
Azure Stream Analytics or Spark-compatible processing
assumptions: Devices connect over mutual TLS where possible
Single primary Azure region with failover playbook
topologyHints: Decouple ingestion from analytics consumers via event hub partitions
